notes: Verification pass 2026-10-29. Lagos town itself still has no named trees (see lagos-pt.json). The only place in the western/central Algarve with a naming body is Monchique: ICNF register, municipal list (cm-monchique.pt) and the Via Algarviana Rota das Arvores Monumentais (3 circuits from Sao Sebastiao Square) all name its trees. Three delivered in data/research/lagos-verified.json with prefix mnq as a Monchique place (about 1.5 h from Lagos by public transport; it is not a Lagos walk). The Via Algarviana EN/PT PDFs hold per-tree detail (glyph-encoded; plain text extraction failed) and the tree list for Silves/Loule stages: a session with a PDF reader should read https://viaalgarviana.org/upload_files/1/1/Rotas_Tematicas_EN/Rota-das-Arvores-Monumentais-ViaAlgarviana-EN-web.pdf to find a fourth Monchique tree (e.g. cork oak at Montinhos da Serra, 18 m, crown 25 m, appeared in search snippet only). Hosts: portuguesetrails.com, viaalgarviana.org PDFs return binary that WebFetch cannot read; geocaching.com, postal.pt, barlavento.pt fine; sulinformacao.pt 403; overpass-api.de 406 to plain curl.
